title: Том 2 — дополнительная литературная вычитка, партия 01 (печатные страницы 3–10)
policy: Russian literary revisions only; preserve source Arabic, all citations including Quran and hadith, doctrinal distinctions, authorial metaphors, IDs, chapter order, existing volume2 editorial fixes, and notes. No independent hadith/theological/source verification.
